newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek stocks jump, seen cruising to 1,100 pts.
newsitem.headline: Greek stocks jump, seen cruising to 1,100 pts.

text.p: The Athens bourse rallied again on Friday gaining 1.95 percent in heavy volume of 13.8 billion drachmas as more news of interest rate cuts hit the market and brokers said the market was headed toward 1,100 points.

"The market was powerful on Friday with strong investment interest from institutionals and retail buyers. The index will test the 1,100 level in the short-run," said broker Tasos Rapakoulias, at Katsoulis Securities.
Profit taking, usually expected after such a strong rise, would not necessary bring the market down, he added.
"Investors will divert from blue chips to shares that have a smaller capitalization and have been left behind," he said.
The Athens general share index climbed 1.95 percent or 20.72 points at 1083.82 from Thursday's 1063.10, after opening at 1059.86.
Friday's turnover was 13.8 billion drachmas on volume of 4.6 million shares. Gainers led losers 136 to 77 with 33 issues unchanged on 246 traded.
